version_id.description: Version ID placeholder (kept verbatim from original file).

sqlite_user_table.description: Name of the user table in the SQLite database.

sqlite_crypt_pwfield.description: Field name for encrypted passwords in the user table.

sqlite_clear_pwfield.description: Field name for cleartext passwords in the user table.

sqlite_default_domain.description: Default domain to append to usernames if no domain is provided.

sqlite_uid_field.description: Field name for user ID in the user table.

sqlite_gid_field.description: Field name for group ID in the user table.

sqlite_login_field.description: Field name used as the login identifier.

sqlite_home_field.description: Field name for user's home directory.

sqlite_name_field.description: Field name for user's full name.

sqlite_defaultdelivery.description: Field name for custom mail delivery instructions.

sqlite_auxoptions_field.description: Field name for auxiliary account options.

sqlite_where_clause.description: Custom WHERE clause to append to authentication queries.

sqlite_select_clause.description: Custom SELECT clause for authentication queries (overrides other field mappings if set).

sqlite_enumerate_clause.description: Custom SQL query for enumerating accounts (used by authenumerate).

sqlite_chpass_clause.description: Custom UPDATE clause for password changes.
